name: 420Token
feePolicy: every successful deployment deposits exactly 42 native 420 into the canonical community Treasury vault through Vault deposit accounting
invariants: TOK-INV-001: every successful deployment costs exactly 42 native 420 and deposits the entire fee atomically into the canonical 420Treasury token-creation community-revenue vault.

TOK-INV-FEE: the factory accepts only the canonical treasury vault ID 420/treasury/vault/token-creation-community-revenue/v1 as its immutable fee destination; no factory operator or administrator can redirect individual deployment fees.
TOK-INV-002: arbitrary caller-supplied bytecode cannot be deployed through 420Token; only frozen V1 template IDs are accepted.
TOK-INV-003: every deployment records token address, creator, template ID/version and configuration hash.
TOK-INV-004: the factory retains no token ownership, mint authority or custody after deployment.
TOK-INV-005: fixed-supply templates cannot mint after construction and capped templates cannot exceed their immutable cap.
TOK-INV-006: Permit signatures are domain-separated by chain ID and verifying contract and consume monotonically increasing nonces.
TOK-INV-007: Votes checkpoints move only with delegated balances and support historical block queries.
TOK-INV-008: ERC721 and ERC1155 safe transfers reject incompatible contract recipients.
TOK-INV-009: governance may disable a compromised V1 template but cannot substitute new executable code under an existing template ID/version.
TOK-INV-010: 420Token deployment does not imply Registry endorsement, Swap liquidity, Launchpad approval, legal status or investment quality.
